sources.title: TILKI - Video Game Creation. Human-Led. AI-Run.
sources.snippet: TILKI is a game model: an AI-native system that builds a living world from your creative intent. You define the vision and TILKI builds the world, populates it with characters that think and act, and runs a simulation so deep that every player's story is different.
